title: A Garden for the Oath Again
author: Hazel Yarrow
blurb: Oscar Whitlock, the youngest member of a dying guild, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when the old gods begin answering prayers again, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
